text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through town on my day off,
I heard excited voices coming from a Chinese restaurant along the street.

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: “—And now, the Choman Restaurant Eating Contest! It's finally underway!”

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
Today as well, hungry challengers drool,
eager to swallow the throne whole!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: —And successfully defending her title for the third time! Here comes the "Northern Stomach Bulldozer," Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I-I'm a bulldozer!
I like extra-large mapo bowls! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, whoa-whoa?!Trainer, why are you here~?!"
choice_data_list: When did you become the champion...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you've got it all wrong, this is...!
Well, one thing led to another...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... A while ago, when I happened to walk
past this shop, a tournament was taking place.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I only entered on a whim, but ended up becoming the champion...
After that, I had to defend my title at every tournament...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I know that...
I understand, but...
As champion, I cannot fail their expectations...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Champion!
Show us that hearty appetite of yours today, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, okay! Yeah!
Umm... HAHAHAHAHA!
Double portion, yeah!
choice_data_list: You're really getting into it, aren't you...
You're really getting into it, huh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I was just asked to make a character
that would appeal to a wide audience...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Please, Trainer!
Can't you let it slide just this once?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make today my retirement match!
Please, I beg of you~!"
choice_data_list: ...Go out there and give yourself a glorious send-off.
Then, only eat until you're about eighty percent full...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much!
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Brothers, listen up!
It's sudden, but today's tournament
will mark my retirement match!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What did you say!? Are you for real, hey!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second! Champion,
you could talk normally this whole time!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So... to make sure I have no regrets today,
I'm gonna eat every single bite! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... Special Week claimed a glorious
victory, retiring as an undefeated champion...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'll do my best!
...As long as I don't gain weight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And though she entered the contest while trying to hold back her appetite...
there were many other big-eating Umamusume taking part—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew... We lost, didn't we?
choice_data_list: That ended up looking kinda rigged, huh...
I guess that ended up looking kinda rigged...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No, it's for the best. Even though I knew it was wrong, it felt like there was no getting off that ride...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to be the 'Number One Umamusume in Japan'!
I'll be counting on you from here on out too,
Trainer! Yeah!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like the Big Eater Champion vibe
is going to linger around for a while.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-What's the matter,
Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gasp!? D-Does that mean... !?
choice_data_list: Show off the King's appetite! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Yeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
HAHAHAHAHAHA!
I-I'm the Stomach Bulldozer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so... Special Week showcased gluttony worthy of a champion, claiming victory in the end.
